metadata.content:
Correct. M46 is incomplete. I inspected the repository directly and found why Phase 5 stopped.
The workspace renders the inspectors with different indentation than the patch expected, and several older section wrappers still contain literal \n text after self-closing components. For example, the actual Chronology block is:
TypeScript<GenesisTemporalChronologyInspector
  projection={
    operational.projection
  }
/>\n
rather than the exact anchor used by the failed patch.
Steps 1–4 already modified the four inspector files locally, and Phase 5 partially added the workspace coordinator before stopping. Do not rerun the entire M46 script. Resume only the unfinished workspace wiring with a structural regex patch that matches the actual file and cleans those residual literal \n markers.
Bashset -euo pipefail

cd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina

WORKSPACE="apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisReplayReadWorkspace.tsx"

echo "===== M46 — RESUME INCOMPLETE WORKSPACE CROSS-NAVIGATION ====="

echo
echo "===== 1. VERIFY PARTIAL COORDINATOR EXISTS ====="

grep -n \
  'artifactNavigationTarget\|navigateToHistoricalArtifact\|GenesisHistoricalArtifactNavigationTarget' \
  "$WORKSPACE" \
  -A8 -B5

echo
echo "===== 2. COMPLETE INSPECTOR WIRING AGAINST ACTUAL SOURCE ====="

python3 <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

p = Path(
    "apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/"
    "GenesisReplayReadWorkspace.tsx"
)

s = p.read_text()

# The failed Phase 5 already added these. Refuse to guess if it did not.
required = [
    "artifactNavigationTarget",
    "navigateToHistoricalArtifact",
    "GenesisHistoricalArtifactNavigationTarget",
]

for token in required:
    if token not in s:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"ERROR: partial M46 coordinator missing: {token}"
        )

def wire_component(
    text: str,
    component: str,
    prop: str,
) -> str:
    # Already wired => leave intact.
    pattern_existing = re.compile(
        rf"<{component}\b"
        rf"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        rf"{re.escape(prop)}="
        rf"(?:(?!/>).)*?/>",
        re.S,
    )

    if pattern_existing.search(text):
        print(
            f"{component}: already wired"
        )
        return text

    # Match the actual current component shape regardless of indentation.
    pattern = re.compile(
        rf"(?P<indent>[ \t]*)"
        rf"<{component}\s*\n"
        rf"(?P<body>"
        rf"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        rf"projection=\{{\s*"
        rf"operational\.projection\s*"
        rf"\}}"
        rf"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        rf")"
        rf"\s*/>"
        rf"(?:\\\\n)?",
        re.S,
    )

    match = pattern.search(
        text
    )

    if not match:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"ERROR: render block not found for {component}"
        )

    indent = match.group(
        "indent"
    )

    body = match.group(
        "body"
    ).rstrip()

    replacement = (
        f"{indent}<{component}\n"
        f"{body}\n"
        f"{indent}  {prop}={{\n"
        f"{indent}    navigateToHistoricalArtifact\n"
        f"{indent}  }}\n"
        f"{indent}/>"
    )

    print(
        f"{component}: wired"
    )

    return (
        text[:match.start()] +
        replacement +
        text[match.end():]
    )

s = wire_component(
    s,
    "GenesisTemporalChronologyInspector",
    "onNavigateToArtifact",
)

s = wire_component(
    s,
    "GenesisHistoricalRelationshipInspector",
    "onNavigateToArtifact",
)

s = wire_component(
    s,
    "GenesisEvolutionEpisodeInspector",
    "onNavigateToArtifact",
)

# Historical Artifact Explorer receives the shared destination target,
# not the callback.
if not re.search(
    r"<GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer\b"
    r"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
    r"navigationTarget=",
    s,
    re.S,
):
    pattern = re.compile(
        r"(?P<indent>[ \t]*)"
        r"<GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer\s*\n"
        r"(?P<body>"
        r"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        r"projection=\{\s*"
        r"operational\.projection\s*"
        r"\}"
        r"(?:(?!/>).)*?"
        r")"
        r"\s*/>"
        r"(?:\\\\n)?",
        re.S,
    )

    match = pattern.search(
        s
    )

    if not match:
        raise SystemExit(
            "ERROR: Historical Artifact Explorer render block not found"
        )

    indent = match.group(
        "indent"
    )

    body = match.group(
        "body"
    ).rstrip()

    replacement = (
        f"{indent}<GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer\n"
        f"{body}\n"
        f"{indent}  navigationTarget={{\n"
        f"{indent}    artifactNavigationTarget\n"
        f"{indent}  }}\n"
        f"{indent}/>"
    )

    s = (
        s[:match.start()] +
        replacement +
        s[match.end():]
    )

    print(
        "GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer: navigation target wired"
    )
else:
    print(
        "GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer: already wired"
    )

# Remove residual literal backslash-n JSX text left by the older
# section-wrapper patch. These are not real line endings.
s = re.sub(
    r"(/>)\\\\n(?=\s*</section>)",
    r"\1",
    s,
)

p.write_text(
    s
)

print(
    "M46 workspace coordinator completed against actual Genesis composition."
)
PY

echo
echo "===== 3. VERIFY ALL FOUR CROSS-NAVIGATION CONNECTIONS ====="

python3 <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

s = Path(
    "apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/"
    "GenesisReplayReadWorkspace.tsx"
).read_text()

checks = {
    "chronology callback":
        "<GenesisTemporalChronologyInspector",
    "relationship callback":
        "<GenesisHistoricalRelationshipInspector",
    "episode callback":
        "<GenesisEvolutionEpisodeInspector",
    "artifact target":
        "<GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer",
}

for label, component in checks.items():
    start = s.index(
        component
    )

    end = s.index(
        "/>",
        start,
    )

    block = s[
        start:end
    ]

    if component == \
        "<GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer":
        token = \
            "navigationTarget"
    else:
        token = \
            "onNavigateToArtifact"

    if token not in block:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"ERROR: {label} not wired"
        )

    print(
        f"{label}: GREEN"
    )

if "\\n" in s:
    # Do not globally ban escape sequences inside strings.
    # Only reject the known malformed JSX residue.
    if "/>\\n" in s:
        raise SystemExit(
            "ERROR: literal JSX \\\\n residue remains"
        )

print(
    "WORKSPACE CROSS-NAVIGATION: GREEN"
)
PY

echo
echo "===== 4. VERIFY COMPLETE M46 SOURCE CONTRACT ====="

grep -n \
  'navigateToHistoricalArtifact\|navigationTarget\|Open Event in Historical Artifacts\|Open From Endpoint\|Open To Endpoint\|Open Episode in Historical Artifacts' \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisReplayReadWorkspace.tsx \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer.tsx \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisTemporalChronologyInspector.tsx \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisHistoricalRelationshipInspector.tsx \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisEvolutionEpisodeInspector.tsx

echo
echo "===== 5. VERIFY BUILDER DOES NOT CREATE HISTORICAL OBJECTS ====="

if grep -nE \
  'createHistoricalEvent|createHistoricalRelationship|createEvolutionEpisode|materializeGenesisHistoricalCorrelation' \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisReplayReadWorkspace.tsx \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer.tsx \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisTemporalChronologyInspector.tsx \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisHistoricalRelationshipInspector.tsx \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/genesis/GenesisEvolutionEpisodeInspector.tsx
then
  echo "ERROR: Builder crossed Runtime historical reconstruction boundary"
  exit 1
fi

echo "RUNTIME SEMANTIC BOUNDARY: GREEN"

echo
echo "===== 6. GENESIS UI CONTRACTS ====="

npm --workspace apps/lumina-builder test -- \
  src/components/workspaces/genesis/__tests__/GenesisEvolutionEpisodeInspector.test.tsx \
  src/components/workspaces/genesis/__tests__/GenesisHistoricalRelationshipInspector.test.tsx \
  src/components/workspaces/genesis/__tests__/GenesisTemporalChronologyInspector.test.tsx \
  src/components/workspaces/genesis/__tests__/GenesisHistoricalArtifactExplorer.test.tsx \
  src/components/workspaces/genesis/__tests__/GenesisOperationalProjectionPanel.test.tsx \
  src/components/workspaces/genesis/__tests__/GenesisReplayReadWorkspace.test.tsx

echo
echo "===== 7. BUILDER BUILD ====="

npm --workspace apps/lumina-builder run build

echo
echo "===== 8. FULL REPOSITORY BUILD ====="

npm run build

echo
echo "===== 9. DIFF SAFETY ====="

git diff --check
git diff --stat
git status --short

echo
echo "===== M46 PHASE 1 COMPLETE — STOP HERE ====="
